content.title: Trex (TREX) Margins Fall to 16.5%, Raising New Doubts on Growth Narrative
content.summary: Trex Company (TREX) is forecasting annual earnings growth of 6.97% and revenue growth of 6.8%, both of which trail the US market averages of 16% and 10.5% respectively. Profit margins have come in at 16.5%, compared to 21.1% the previous year. This reflects a recent decline in annual earnings despite a longer-term upward trend of 3% per year over five years.
